messages:
Devon (oncall): dedicated-eu-central pool at 98% GPU allocation, queues starting to climb. seeing request throttles for low-priority tenants.
sre-bot: ALERT: pool=eu-central-dedicated usage=98% (512/525 GPUs). Queue depth +420. IncidentID INC-2026-1987.
Maria G: any scheduled large jobs? i'm seeing a spike in batch/vision pipelines around 09:02 UTC.
Ajay R: running quick top-talkers query

```
redwoodctl audit tenant-usage --pool eu-central-dedicated --top 10
# output: visionlabs 28%, quickchat 12%, beta-corp 8%, misc-batch 22%
```
Devon (oncall): thanks. short plan: 1) enable controlled spillover -> hosted for non-critical traffic, 2) drain batch-tagged nodes, 3) whitelist enterprise tenants to remain on dedicated. we want minimal latency impact for SLAs.
Lee: agree. protect enterprise SKUs. move low-tier + batch to hosted. notify sales/customer-ops.
Maria G: starting drain for batch nodes now:
```
redwoodctl node drain --pool eu-central-dedicated --tags=batch --grace-period=300
```
sre-bot: autoscaler attempted +4 nodes but failed: cloud quota exceeded for GPU cores in eu-central. opened quota_event Q-4521.
Ajay R: cloud quota is blocking scale-up. we can either wait for quota or shift more traffic to hosted. suggest bump fallback_ratio to 0.3 (30%) and canary it.
Devon (oncall): applying routing change to move ~30% outbound to hosted. command:
```
infractl routing update --pool eu-central-dedicated --fallback_ratio 0.30 --whitelist enterprise/* --apply-now
```
ops-bot: routing update applied (change_id r-9012). observed traffic shift: 28% -> hosted over 3m.
Devon (oncall): metrics update: median latency hosted +45ms, p95 +120ms for some workloads but error rate steady. queue depth on dedicated decreasing.
Maria G: draft customer note for impacted low-tier customers and heads-up for enterprise: short apology + info on mitigation and ETA. posting to #customer-ops in 5.
Lee: cost note: expected hosted spend +12%/hr while this persists. we should log this for finance review.
Ajay R: follow-ups: 1) continue quota appeal with cloud (ticket opened), 2) evaluate rebalancing reservations across regions, 3) look at KV cache hits for visionlabs (maybe cache pressure causing longer token runs).
Devon (oncall): leaving runbook items in the incident doc. current status: pool stabilized at 75% post-shift, queued work draining. marking incident as mitigated but keeping monitoring on for 1h. :thumbsup:
Maria G: posted customer comms. will update if enterprise customers report anything.
sre-bot: RESOLVED ALERT: pool_saturation_high -> usage dropped to 74%.
Devon (oncall): nice work team. final actions: confirm cloud quota resolution, plan reserved capacity bump for next quarter, and add automated tiered-evac policy to avoid manual drains next time. closing thread soon.
